My French is rusty: My French is rusty because I haven't spoken it since I left Paris ten years ago.
我的法語生疏了，因為自從十年前離開巴黎後我就沒再說過。
get rusty: I haven't spoken Japanese for years, so I've started to get rusty and often forget simple words.
我好幾年沒說日語了，所以開始變得生疏，常常忘記簡單的單字。
a rusty voice: After shouting at the concert all night, he woke up with a rusty voice and could barely speak.
在演唱會上喊了一整晚之後，他醒來時聲音沙啞，幾乎說不出話。
rusty skills: After five years without driving, I took a few lessons to brush up my rusty skills before the road trip.
五年沒開車後，我在公路旅行前上了幾堂課，把生疏的技能練回來。
a sacred duty: Many people believe that voting is a sacred duty that every citizen should take seriously.
許多人認為投票是每個公民都應該認真看待的神聖職責。
a sacred cow: In our town, the old temple festival is a sacred cow, and nobody dares to suggest cancelling it.
在我們鎮上，古老的廟會是神聖不可侵犯的事物，沒人敢提議取消它。
sacred texts: Monks spend many years studying sacred texts such as the Bible, the Koran, and Buddhist sutras.
僧侶花許多年研讀宗教經典，例如聖經、可蘭經和佛經。
hold something sacred: My grandfather holds family dinners sacred and never lets anyone miss them, even for work.
我爺爺把家庭晚餐視為神聖，從不讓任何人缺席，即使是為了工作也不行。
Nothing is sacred: These comedians make jokes about everyone, even the president; nothing is sacred on their show.
這些喜劇演員拿每個人開玩笑，連總統也不放過；在他們的節目裡沒什麼不能批評。
a satisfactory explanation: The teacher asked why I was late again, but I couldn't give a satisfactory explanation.
老師問我為什麼又遲到，但我無法給出令人滿意的解釋。
satisfactory progress: My son has made satisfactory progress in math this term, so his teacher is quite pleased.
我兒子這學期在數學上有令人滿意的進展，所以他的老師相當高興。
in satisfactory condition: The used car I bought is in satisfactory condition, so I only had to change its tires.
我買的二手車狀況良好，所以我只需要換輪胎。
less than satisfactory: The hotel service was less than satisfactory, so we asked the manager for a partial refund.
飯店的服務不盡理想，所以我們要求經理部分退款。
scarce resources: In poor villages, families must share scarce resources such as clean water, food, and medicine.
在貧窮的村莊裡，家家戶戶必須共享乾淨的水、食物和藥品等稀缺資源。
be scarce: During the long drought, fresh vegetables were scarce, so prices at the market doubled.
在漫長的乾旱期間，新鮮蔬菜短缺，所以市場上的價格翻了一倍。
make oneself scarce: When my parents started arguing about money, I made myself scarce and quietly went to my room.
當我爸媽開始為錢吵架時，我就溜走，悄悄回到自己的房間。
a scary thought: Losing all my photos in a computer crash is a scary thought, so I back them up every week.
電腦當機而失去所有照片是個可怕的念頭，所以我每週都備份。
a scary movie: We watched a scary movie last night, and my little sister couldn't sleep because of the ghosts.
我們昨晚看了一部恐怖片，我妹妹因為片中的鬼而睡不著。
scary stories: At summer camp, we sat around the fire telling scary stories about a ghost in the woods.
在夏令營時，我們圍坐在火堆旁講關於森林裡鬼魂的恐怖故事。
It's scary how…: It's scary how quickly a small fire can spread through a dry forest in summer.
夏天時一場小火在乾燥森林裡蔓延得那麼快，真可怕。
scientific evidence: There is strong scientific evidence that smoking causes lung cancer and heart disease.
有強而有力的科學證據顯示吸菸會導致肺癌和心臟病。
the scientific method: In biology class, we learned the scientific method: ask a question, test it, and draw conclusions.
在生物課上，我們學了科學方法：提出問題、進行測試，然後得出結論。
a scientific approach: The doctors took a scientific approach, testing each possible cause of the illness one by one.
醫生們採取科學的方法，一個接一個地檢驗這種疾病的每個可能原因。
scientific research: Scientific research on climate change helps governments make better decisions about energy.
關於氣候變遷的科學研究幫助政府在能源方面做出更好的決定。
scientific literacy: Schools should improve students' scientific literacy so they can judge the health news they read online.
學校應該提升學生的科學素養，讓他們能判斷在網路上讀到的健康新聞。
a secure job: My father has a secure job at the bank, so our family never worries about money.
我爸爸在銀行有一份穩定的工作，所以我們家從不擔心錢的問題。
feel secure: Babies feel secure when their parents hold them close and speak to them in a soft voice.
當父母緊緊抱著嬰兒並輕聲對他們說話時，嬰兒會感到安心。
a secure future: Saving money every month will help you build a secure future for your children.
每個月存錢能幫助你為孩子打造一個有保障的未來。
secure a victory: Our team scored in the final minute to secure a victory over last year's champions.
我們隊在最後一分鐘得分，確保了對去年冠軍的勝利。
a secure connection: Always use a secure connection when you shop online so that hackers cannot steal your card number.
網購時一定要使用安全的連線，這樣駭客才偷不到你的卡號。
financially secure: After working hard for thirty years, my grandparents are financially secure and can enjoy their retirement.
努力工作三十年後，我的祖父母在經濟上有保障，可以享受退休生活。
